system.description:
You manifest a dazzling array of flashing, colored lights, that spring forth from your hand. Creatures in a 15-foot cone, originating from you must make an Intelligence saving throw.

Critical Success: This creature ignores the effects of this jutsu.

Success: Affected creature gain 1 rank of Dazzled, until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creatures takes 2d6 psychic damage and gain 1 rank of Dazzled.

Critical Failure: Affected creatures becomes Blinded and must remake their saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end this jutsu’s effects on them.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the size of the cone by +5 feet. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Dazzled inflicted by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the ranks of Dazzled inflicted by +1.
